description: The file implements a React component for listing, searching, filtering, and managing assets within a frontend application. It includes features like fetching asset data from an API, client-side filtering, pagination, and user role-based permission controls for actions like view, copy, create, and delete.

methods.name: AssetsListPage
methods.description: Main React component that renders the asset list page with search, pagination, and action controls.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of an asset with confirmation, permission check, and API call.
